jobs.description:
About The Role

The role drives complex technical initiatives end-to-end, aligning engineering, product, and design teams to deliver software solutions on schedule.

The Project Manager removes blockers, manages dependencies across distributed squads, and establishes predictable delivery cadences using modern agile tooling.

Key Responsibilities

Plan and execute complex technical projects using Jira, Confluence, and GitHub to track epics, sprints, and milestones
Facilitate agile ceremonies including daily standups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and cross-team syncs
Identify and mitigate project risks, resolving cross-functional bottlenecks before they impact delivery timelines
Partner with engineering leads to scope features, define acceptance criteria, and manage capacity planning
Communicate project health, key metrics, and roadmap updates clearly to engineering leadership and stakeholders

What We Are Looking For

4-7 years of technical project or program management experience within software engineering environments
Deep familiarity with agile and scrum methodologies, including Jira administration and sprint metric tracking
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous technical requirements into structured execution plans
Exceptional facilitation, conflict resolution, and written communication skills
Bonus: PMP, CSM, or PMI-ACP certification; prior software engineering background

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Project Manager, International Development Programs
(Bilingual English/French)
Location Ottawa (Hybrid) or Remote within Canada
Position Type Full-Time
Salary CAD $70,000 per annum, plus annual performance bonus
Reports To President & CEO

About CLIC Consultants
Canadian Leaders in International Consulting Inc. (CLIC Consultants) is a Canadian
international development consulting firm specializing in governance, public sector reform,
monitoring, evaluation, research and learning (MERL), socio-economic development, food
security, agriculture, environmental sustainability, and institutional strengthening. We
work with bilateral and multilateral donors, governments, civil society organizations, and
international agencies across Africa, the Middle East, and other developing regions.

Position Summary
CLIC Consultants is seeking a highly motivated and bilingual Project Manager to support the management and growth of its international development portfolio. The successful candidate will have demonstrated experience managing donor funded projects, particularly those funded by Global Affairs Canada (GAC), and a strong track record in proposal writing and business development. The Project Manager will oversee project implementation, donor compliance, stakeholder engagement, financial monitoring, reporting, and proposal development while ensuring high-quality delivery of consulting assignments.
This position is ideal for a development professional seeking increasing responsibility within a growing international consulting firm.

Key Responsibilities
Project Management
• Manage the implementation of international development projects funded by GAC and
other donors.
• Develop and maintain project workplans, implementation schedules, risk registers, and
monitoring frameworks.
• Coordinate consultants, technical experts, partner organizations, and project
stakeholders.
• Monitor project progress against contractual obligations, deliverables, budgets, and
performance indicators.
• Prepare high-quality technical and financial reports for donors and clients.
Ensure compliance with donor regulations, contractual requirements, and organizational policies.

• Support mission planning, logistics coordination, consultant recruitment, and quality
assurance processes.
• Identify implementation risks and recommend mitigation strategies.

Proposal Development and Business Development
• Work closely with the Business Development unit to prepare and coordinate proposal
development processes for GAC, World Bank, UN agencies, multilateral organizations,
foundations, and international NGOs.
• Review solicitation documents, terms of reference, notices of funding opportunities, and
requests for proposals.
• Draft and edit technical proposals, corporate capability statements, and expressions of
interest.
• Conduct background research, stakeholder analysis, and contextual assessments.

Client and Stakeholder Engagement
• Build and maintain positive working relationships with clients, donors, partners, and
consultants.
• Participate in project meetings, workshops, and stakeholder consultations.
• Represent CLIC Consultants professionally in interactions with external stakeholders.
• Support identification of strategic partnership opportunities.

Qualifications
Education
• Master's degree in International Development, Public Administration, Public Policy,
Political Science, International Relations, Economics, Social Sciences, Evaluation, or a
related field or a relevant undergraduate degree combined with extensive experience.

Experience
• Minimum 3 to 5 years of relevant professional experience in international development.
• Demonstrated experience managing donor-funded projects.
• Experience working on projects funded by Global Affairs Canada (GAC) is a strong asset
• Proven experience preparing or contributing to successful donor proposals.
• Experience managing budgets, workplans, consultants, and project delivery processes.
• Experience working in developing countries is considered a strong asset.
• Experience in 2 or more sectors including governance, public sector reform, MERL,
agriculture, food security, climate change, gender equality, or economic development is
desirable.
Language Requirements

• Fluency in English and French (spoken and written) is required.

Knowledge and Skills
• Strong project planning and organizational abilities.
• An understanding of Global Affairs Canada programming and reporting requirements
is highly desirable
• Excellent proposal writing and technical writing skills.
• Experience using Results-Based Management (RBM) approaches.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder engagement skills.
• Ability to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously.
• Proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and
SharePoint.
• Proficiency in one or more M&E and research applications such as SPSS, Power BI etc
and use of AI is an asset
• Ability to work independently in a fast-paced consulting environment.

Performance Bonus
The employee will be eligible for an annual performance bonus based on:
• Achievement of individual performance objectives.
• Successful project delivery.
• Quality of client service.
• Contribution to proposal development efforts.
• Revenue generated through successful proposal submissions and business
development activities.

What We Offer
• Competitive salary of CAD $70,000 per year.
• Annual performance-based bonus.
• Flexible and hybrid working arrangements.
• Professional development opportunities.
• Exposure to international development projects and leading donor organizations.
• Opportunity to contribute to meaningful development outcomes around the world.

To apply, please submit a cover letter and CV by email to info@clic-consultants.com
by September 15, 2026.

Please put in subject line: Project Manager Position Application.

Please note that only those shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

Job Description:

Compensation Range

Minimum Rate

$ 105,000.00 CAD

Maximum Rate

$ 125,000.00 CAD

Who We Are

Trapeze Software Inc. is part of Modaxo’s transit portfolio, and an operating group of Constellation Software Inc. We design and deploy best-in-class technologies like enterprise asset management, workforce management, mobility solutions, and more for public transportation agencies. Our technology helps our customers find new ways to increase ridership, improve passenger experience, and achieve operational excellence. At Trapeze, we strive to ensure our employees succeed in all aspects of their career. Our culture provides individuals with ability and opportunity to collaborate, learn and grow. We will provide you with the resources, responsibilities, guidance, and freedom needed to be successful. Building strong and long-lasting relationships are a vital component to working with us. Join our team and be on the way to a rewarding and fulfilling career!

The Trapeze EAM business unit is part of Modaxo’s transit portfolio, within Constellation Software Inc. Trapeze EAM designs and deploys best-in-class technologies in enterprise asset management. Trapeze EAM’s transit-focused solutions help customers transform their business by optimizing maintenance workflows and enabling them to stay on top of regulatory compliance. Trapeze EAM enables transit customers to track and maintain assets in the areas of rolling stock, facilities, and linear/maintenance-of-way. The Trapeze EAM business is growing significantly.

What We Are Looking For

Shape the future of transit. Your journey begins here. We are Trapeze EAM, a leader in enterprise asset management software, and we need a Senior Project Manager for our team. The Senior Project Manager leads the delivery of complex, high-impact projects with a high degree of autonomy. This role is accountable for successful delivery outcomes, financial performance, and customer satisfaction, while acting as a trusted advisor to customers and internal stakeholders.

Location
This is a fully remote opportunity with up to 15% travel.

Responsibilities

Lead and manage assigned contracts, service agreements, and projects from initiation through closeout with a high degree of autonomy, ensuring scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk objectives are achieved.
Plan, organize, and execute complex EAM software delivery and implementation projects involving internal teams, customer stakeholders, and external partners.
Manage project scope, timelines, quality, goals, and deliverables in alignment with business objectives, proactively advising stakeholders on impacts to cost, schedule, and outcomes.
Develop, maintain, and actively manage detailed project schedules, forecasts, and cost performance throughout the project lifecycle.
Lead change management by assessing impacts, guiding customers and internal teams through decisions, and ensuring changes are clearly documented, approved, and communicated.
Maintain and actively manage project risk registers, ensuring early visibility of risks with clear mitigation strategies, ownership, and follow-through.
Facilitate regular project status meetings with customers, ensuring clear communication of progress, risks, dependencies, and next steps.
Conduct executive-level steering meetings with customer leadership and internal executive sponsors.
Serve as the primary point of accountability and escalation for project delivery, proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and challenges, and leading resolution efforts.
Build and maintain strong internal and external relationships, acting as a trusted advisor and escalation point for key stakeholders.
Demonstrate strong understanding of software and hardware implementation activities, including the mechanics of deployment, integration, and customer adoption.
Set and continually manage project expectations with team members, customers, and other stakeholders.
Develop and deliver executive-ready reporting, proposals, requirements documentation, issue logs, action item registers, and presentations, as required.
Contribute to the development, improvement, and standardization of project management processes, tools, and best practices across the organization.
Lead project postmortems and implementation reviews, producing actionable recommendations and lessons learned.
Manage requirement compliance matrices and other governance artifacts to ensure contractual obligations and delivery commitments are clearly tracked and met.

Qualifications

5+ years of experience as a vendor-based Project Manager in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
Experience managing multiple concurrent engagements with diverse system, contractual, and customer requirements.
5+ years of experience in consulting, business analysis, software delivery, or systems integration environments.
Proven ability to independently lead complex, multi-stakeholder projects from initiation through closeout.
Experience managing software delivery or systems integration projects under Fixed Price and Time & Materials models.
Strong consulting, business analysis, stakeholder facilitation, and executive communication skills.
PMP certification preferred, or actively working toward certification.
Ability to travel up to 15%, including occasional evenings or weekends as needed.

Nice to have

Experience working with Smartsheet or comparable project management tools.
Experience working in Enterprise Asset Management, transit technology, or a related software delivery environment.

What's in it for you?

Benefits: Our plans include coverage options for many of life’s needs and a focus on wellness programs that are right for you.

Financial Perks: Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Company Bonus Plan, Referral Bonus Program, discounts for home/auto insurance, and many more.

Flexibility: Choose working hours that work best for you within the core business hours.

Tuition Reimbursement: A commitment to continuous improvement and employee development through our Professional Development Program. Tuition fees and books are reimbursed at 100%. Some restrictions may apply.

Computer Purchase Plan: Upgrade your personal equipment at home with financial support from Trapeze as part of our computer purchase plan.

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

Remote - USA (East Coast)

Job Description Summary

Be responsible for the day-to-day oversight and close out of allocated patient concierge projects and to liaise with the PCS Coordination team, Finance, and IT (INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY), delivering the project until completion in accordance with the appropriate clinical SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), GCP (Good Clinical Practice) and all applicable regulatory requirements.

    Work with the PCS Concierge Coordinators (PCS PCCs) to arrange the set-up of the trial environment within the PatientGO portal.
    Lead the process of document creation and translation for site and ethics ready patient facing material, in conjunction with the global start-up team. Give guidance to the client on Travel and Expense Reimbursement Policy set-up and management, with the aim to minimise patient burden and maximise the potential of their retention.
    Develop a clear understanding of the study budget and its scope, managing it to the point of completion and reconciliation. Prepare accurate financial and activity forecasts for the lifetime of the project and report actual performance against forecast. Prepare monthly invoices based on project activity. Identify changes in scope and seek client approval for change orders.
    Manage external vendors providing services to the project ensuring they meet Service Level Agreements and other contractual agreements.
    Conduct monthly project reviews and report progress identifying achievements and issues with overall study progress, finances, client relationships, project risks, resource, and vendors. Attend project review meetings as required and escalate issues to Senior Management.
    Work to generate opportunities for collaboration with Illingworth s Research Nursing and Medical Imaging divisions, to help deliver holistic solutions for the benefit of clients and their patients.
    Stay informed on the requirements of your role, the industry and challenges faced by patients and clients across the therapeutic areas PCS supports, identifying personal development opportunities and training needs for you and your colleagues. Maintain and share knowledge of all relevant guidance, regulations, and procedures with other PCS team members to ensure best practice.
    Work with PCS PCC team to set up and distribute expense reimbursement materials and patient welcome packs and lead the creation of new content where necessary.
    Maintain effective project related communications between the other Illingworth business units, clients, clinical trial sites and vendors to ensure excellent relationships continue and all parties are kept up to date with project progress. This includes sending invitations, leading meetings, and taking notes of discussion points and actions to share with attendees post-meeting in a timely manner. In the event that PCS is collaborating on a project with IRG s Research Nursing (RN) division, coordinate with RN Project Leads to ensure a joined-up approach for the client.
    Review and approve project timesheets, comparing work completed against visit trackers and budget allowances, requesting team members to correct entries where required.
  Participate in possible face-to-face client and vendor related meetings, these

will require travel both home and abroad.

    Working with the Director of Patient Concierge Services and Business Development to develop and grow the service and team.
    Retain the lead whilst working closely with the PCS Commercial Manager to ensure all change orders are executed in a timely and efficient manner.
    Ensure that assigned projects centrally stored oversight trackers are complete and up to date always, to ensure appropriate business continuity measures are met.
  Responsibilities include:

    For allocated projects, upon handover from the Illingworth Global Project Start-Up (GPSU) team be the first point of contact for both CRO (Contract Research Organisation) and sponsor clients, project issues, heads of trial sites, vendors, and Illingworth business units and functions, liaising with the AD PCS and Senior Director of PCS for issue management and resolution.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

http://www.syneoshealth.com

We are looking for our next Project Manage
r (hybrid mode) to drive the execution of NPI and sustaining projects across our business unit, manage cross-functional development projects from concept through production launch, in our company MKS based in Crewe
(UK).
Reporting to the Director of Project Management and working closely with engineering directors and functional leads, this role requires the ability to coordinate cross-functional teams, maintain disciplined project tracking, and communicate status clearly and transparently. The right candidate is proactive, technically curious, and comfortable operating in a matrixed environment where building relationships is essential to getting things done .

You Will Make an Impact By:

Manage execution of multiple projects across the product development lifecycle, including scope, schedule, budget, and risk management
Coordinate across engineering, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and business teams to drive project milestones and resolve blockers
Build and maintain project schedules, tracking task dependencies and surfacing risks and delays early enough to act on them
Track project financials including budget consumption and variance reporting, escalating concerns before they become problems
Prepare and lead project status at gate reviews and regular program reviews, with clear and accurate communication of progress, risks, and open issues
Maintain project documentation consistent with ISO quality system requirements, ensuring deliverables and decisions are traceable and audit-ready
Identify resource conflicts and scope changes early, working with functional managers to resolve them or framing escalations with recommended actions
Support the division's project prioritization process by maintaining accurate and current project data

Skills You Bring:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required
5+ years of related industrial experience required
Experience managing cross-functional projects with engineering, manufacturing, and quality stakeholders
Technical proficiency – comfortable in technical discussions, with background in engineering (e.g. electronics) and/or analytical product development preferred
Working knowledge of stage-gate or similar product development processes
Ability to build and maintain project schedules with clear dependency tracking
Comfortable working in matrixed environments without direct authority over project team members
Continuous improvement mindset – apply MKS Product Development Process to the project objectives and develop process and teamworking principles to continuously improve outcomes

Ability to travel up to 15%

Preferred Skills:

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, or a related technical discipline strongly preferred

CAPM, PRINCE2 Foundation, or equivalent entry-level certification. Working toward PMP/APM PMQ a plus

Description

Title:
Project Manager

Division:
Project Management

Edinburgh

Why RLB?

At RLB, we live by four simple ideas: Truth, Trust, Together, Tomorrow.
Four values that live at the heart of RLB. A place where People Make Progress.

We value your skills, talents and unique perspectives – we think they are priceless.

Bring them to RLB and you’ll be empowered to shape our future and your career in new and meaningful ways.

We’ll give you opportunities to work on some of the most ambitious and exciting projects currently being designed and developed in the built environment sector.

You’ll continue to learn and advance as everyone who works for us is provided with a tailored training programme. Our mentoring and reverse mentoring schemes will enable you to share your expertise while gaining fresh insights.

What makes RLB unique is our inclusive culture. As an independent, employee-owned business, teamwork and collaboration lies at the heart of everything we do. Hybrid and flexible working arrangements and family-friendly policies are just some of the ways we invest in employee wellbeing.

Join us and you will thrive personally as well as professionally.

Overview Of Role

We are currently recruiting a Project Manager for our Edinburgh Office. This is an exciting opportunity for an entrepreneurial individual to join and strengthen our Project Management offering and presents an excellent prospect for a proactive individual to take responsibility for providing all core Project Management services on several interesting projects.

You will gain valuable project and client exposure, be given responsibility for your own projects and be offered a platform to progress with genuine support from the team and wider business to achieve your career goals.

Role Responsibilities

To carry out assigned duties efficiently and in accordance with processes and procedures.
Comply with established procurement/commercial/contractual strategies.
Take personal responsibility for complying with Environmental, Health, Safety, Security and Quality Standards.
Management and preparation of key stage reports from feasibility through to completion and post-handover.
Preparation of various programmes.
Management of meetings, taking and preparation of minutes.
Preparation of progress reports and presentation at monthly client meetings.
Running a competitive tender process including managing queries from tendering contractors.
Assistance with the preparation of contract documents.
Management of multi-disciplinary project teams.
Working knowledge of various forms of building contracts.
Experience of Administering building contracts.

Person Specification

The ideal candidate will demonstrate a positive proactive approach to the role, and will be committed to delivering customer service excellence, with good commercial results.

Experience

Contract Administration experience.
Ability to identify and develop potential opportunities to secure more business for RLB
Well organised, diligent, proactive, assertive, well-disciplined, and commercially astute.
A track record of working with teams and managing projects by prioritising workloads and delivering to deadlines

Qualifications

Construction Project Management degree or a similar construction related qualification with experience gained within a similar role.
Chartered or equivalent professional qualification or currently working toward – we will provide all necessary support to help you achieve this.

Behaviours

Recognised as a client focused, positive collaborator who shares knowledge freely and offers support to their peers and seniors. Recognised as a team player with a strong willingness to learn.
Demonstrates a positive and proactive approach to the role, and will be committed to delivering customer service excellence, with good commercial results.

RLB Employee Benefits

Our culture is built around enabling you to fulfil your potential, so you can look forward to benefits that include:

Hybrid Working - Working patterns to support your work-life balance. As well as competitive maternity and paternity packages.

Well-Rewarded - A competitive salary and generous holiday entitlement. As well as the opportunity to purchase up to five extra days.

Focus On Wellbeing - We offer a number of health and wellness options, including gym membership and cycle to work schemes.

Healthcare Packages - Private healthcare insurance and medical support, including dental insurance and eyecare vouchers.

Personal Development - A continuous learning and development programme, including established APC and in-house mentoring schemes.

Additional Benefits - We offer a wide range of benefits including a season ticket loan and professional membership subscriptions.

Exceptional Exposure - You’ll have the opportunity to work on diverse projects across different sectors and regions.

Social Responsibility - We hold team and social events as well as charity fundraising and volunteering activities.

Our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Commitment

We believe in building a diverse and inclusive environment where each person can be themselves, feel valued for their contribution and be challenged and supported to reach their full potential. We have a responsibility to support the communities in which we live and work, and that our workforce should reflect these communities and our clients. Our talent strategy should enable us to overcome bias in the construction industry by recruiting, retaining, developing, and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce.

As a Disability Confident employer, we offer a guaranteed interview to applicants with either hidden or physical disabilities who meet the essential criteria for the role. This guarantees an interview, not an offer of employment.

Job Description

Project Manager - Aviation Sustainability & Resilience

Greater Toronto Area

At EXP, we’re driven to provide innovative solutions for the world’s built and natural environments. As a team of engineers, architects, designers, scientists, creators and a community of professionals, we bring diverse and talented people together to solve the world’s most complex challenges. Here, you join a team that leverages differences, harnesses their entrepreneurial spirit in an employee-owned company, that believes diversity is what gives us strength, seeks sustainable results and shares ambitions for each other, our clients and the communities we are part of and serve. To be a part of EXP means to have your own experience, while staying connected to a global network of professionals, who believe we are a part of something bigger. Together, we are EXP.

Are you ready to design your future?

Be our next  Project Manager - Aviation Sustainability & Resilience

Your work environment at EXP

In this role, you will be a part of our regional Aviation team, for exciting Infrastructure projects in the United States & Canada. This position can be remote and/or hybrid based out of one of our major offices preferably in the Greater Toronto Area.

What a day at EXP has in store for you

Serve as a trusted member of the team, working together to provide tailored sustainability strategy, design and solutions to our clients.
Support sustainability strategy development and certification efforts (e.g., LEED, WELL, PMP, CEM, ENV, etc.).
Strong professional network, industry association participation, linked-in presence, and conference presentation experience considered an asset.
Help communicate with and engage stakeholders pertinent to each client’s sustainability strategy, educating all on the value of sustainability and the impact of sustainability strategies and initiatives.
Assist with renewable energy analysis, greenhouse gas inventories, embodied carbon LCA, and carbon neutral building assessments.

Drive Program Planning & Execution – Define program scope, milestones, and success criteria with SRE engineers and leaders. Manage dependencies across platform teams, keep work clearly tracked in Jira, and deliver on time
Strengthen Production Reliability – Lead change management and launch readiness programs. Partner with SREs and product teams to define and operationalize SLOs/SLIs, and use incident data, metrics, and capacity signals to drive prioritization and continuous improvement
Lead Cross-Functional Coordination – Align SRE with Security, Compliance, Cloud platform, and other engineering teams. Coordinate cross-team incident response, ensure clear follow-through, and build trust as the go-to driver of complex, multi-team efforts
Build Scalable Systems & Processes – Design lightweight frameworks and communication patterns that help SRE deliver reliably at scale. Work yourself out of the "hero" role by leaving teams better-equipped to execute independently

Requirements

8+ years in technical program management, engineering management, or a comparable technical role partnering with software engineering teams
Proven track record leading large-scale, cross-team platform initiatives through ambiguity and change
Strong knowledge of production change management, software development lifecycle, and reliability metrics (SLOs, SLIs)
Skilled at shaping roadmaps and managing dependencies
Able to query and interpret metrics, logs, or other data sources to inform decisions and communicate risk
Excellent communicator—clear, concise, and calm—across engineers, cross-functional partners, and executives
Low-ego, highly collaborative, and motivated by ownership of hard problems end to end

Nice to Have

Hands-on or close-partner experience with Kubernetes, cloud networking, or observability stacks (metrics, logs, tracing, alerting)
Prior experience working with or alongside SRE teams
Background in large-scale cloud infrastructure or platform engineering
Familiarity with MongoDB Atlas or other modern cloud database platforms

Why This Role

This role puts MongoDB's values into practice. You'll own hard, ambiguous problems end to end. You'll build together with SRE, engineering, Security, and Compliance to co-create solutions that work across the organization. And you'll think big—scaling the platform and practices that power MongoDB's next phase of growth. MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. jobs.description:
Build your big career with the firm that does Big Law, Better
. McDermott Will & Schulte is a leading global law firm that brings together more than 1,700+ lawyers and 1,400 business professionals. We celebrate excellence, collaboration, and community and have been recognized as a top workplace by USA Today, Fortune , The American Lawyer, Vault and others. We are also certified by Great Place to Work.

At McDermott, we don’t just invest in your future, we accelerate your career – wherever it may lead. That includes supporting you both in and outside of the office.

With Us, You’ll Find

A firm where everyone belongs: Our award-winning culture prioritizes warmth and authenticity — we encourage you to be yourself!
Enthusiasm for all perspectives: We’re smarter and stronger when everyone has a voice and a seat at the table. We welcome unique viewpoints and ideas, and we make opportunities for you and your career to thrive.
Support to feel your best and do your best: Wellness is integral to building a successful career and a rich life. That’s why our benefits program supports your physical, emotional, mental, and financial health, with an emphasis on work-life balance.
Real rewards for real work: We offer generous compensation packages that recognize hard work and excellence.

Job Description

Position Summary:

The Project Manager leads enterprise-wide initiatives that modernize the firm’s technology ecosystem and support AI-driven transformation. This role manages high-visibility programs involving SaaS platforms, custom applications, enterprise infrastructure, data ecosystems, integrations, platform modernization, GenAI deployments and AI-enabled capabilities to support seamless business solutions and workflow enhancements. The Project Manager partners with technology, business, innovation, and executive stakeholders to develop actionable delivery plans, communicate risks and value, evaluate competing priorities, and drive alignment across cross-functional teams. This position operates with minimal oversight and relies on significant experience, strategic judgment, and decision-making skills to plan and accomplish objectives.

Essential Functions And Responsibilities

Program /Project & Delivery Leadership

Lead enterprise‑scale tech, digital, and AI programs; own end‑to‑end delivery and governance
Manage scope, budget, timelines, risks, quality, and cross‑team dependencies
Lead medium- to large-scale technical, digital transformation, and AI-enabled programs across the enterprise
Drive end-to-end delivery across software development, systems integration, infrastructure, and AI implementation workstreams
Translate complex business objectives into actionable strategies, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes
Establish governance frameworks, delivery standards, risk mitigation plans, and executive reporting structures
Manage project scope, budgets, timelines, dependencies, quality controls, and stakeholder alignment throughout the project lifecycle
Build and maintain detailed project plans while balancing competing priorities, evolving business needs, and delivery commitments
Partner with technical teams to ensure solutions meet integration, security, governance, and operational readiness requirements
Maintain program documentation, audit readiness, and decision traceability for enterprise initiatives

Strategic Decision-Making & Problem Solving

Drive prioritization, resourcing, issue resolution, and scalable solution recommendations
Anticipate challenges, mitigate risks early, and apply structured analytical judgment
Lead strategic decision-making related to scope, prioritization, resourcing, sequencing, and delivery execution across complex technical and AI-enabled initiatives
Evaluate operational, technical, business, and governance considerations to recommend scalable, sustainable, and enterprise-aligned solutions
Proactively identify, assess, mitigate, and escalate risks, issues, and decision points while presenting actionable recommendations and resolution strategies
Apply a structured and analytical approach to problem-solving by anticipating challenges, recognizing risks early, and developing practical solutions beyond the obvious
Exercise sound independent judgment with significant day-to-day impact on project direction, delivery strategy, and overall program success
Maintain the highest level of confidentiality and discretion regarding firm, client, and AI-enabled information, systems, integrations, and data sources

Stakeholder & Team Leadership

Align executives, business, and technical teams; communicate clearly; resolve blockers
Motivate teams, foster accountability, and maintain delivery excellence
Serve as a trusted liaison between executive leadership, business stakeholders, technical teams, vendors, and external partners
Facilitate alignment across cross-functional teams with competing priorities and complex decision-making requirements
Present technical and AI-related concepts, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to executive leadership in a clear and actionable manner
Lead and motivate project teams while fostering accountability, collaboration, and delivery excellence
Build strong relationships across business, technical, and governance stakeholders to support successful program execution
Deliver executive presentations, dashboards, status reporting, and communications that clearly reflect project health, milestones, risks, and outcomes
Resolve blockers, resource constraints, and delivery challenges in fast-paced and high-pressure environments

Technical Competencies

Oversee integrations, APIs, cloud platforms, AI lifecycle, and Agile delivery tools
Experience managing enterprise integrations, APIs, data flows, cloud-based platforms, and enterprise applications
Understanding of AI implementation lifecycle considerations, including governance, evaluation, testing, adoption, operational support, and responsible AI practices
Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Smartsheet, or similar platforms
Experience coordinating technical dependencies across infrastructure, security, application development, and data teams

Job Specifications

At least five (5) years of progressive project or program management experience leading enterprise technology initiatives
Bachelor’s degree
Experience within a law firm, consulting, or professional services organization
Business analysis and/or technical writing experience
Experience with enterprise change management and digital transformation initiatives
Certifications such as:
PMP
Agile/Scrum
ITIL
SAFe

AI-related certifications
Ability to manage complex software development and systems integration projects
Ability to deliver AI/ML or Generative AI initiatives in enterprise environments
Strong understanding of project management methodologies including Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery models
Ability to manage enterprise-level stakeholders, including executive leadership
Ability to manage multiple high-priority initiatives simultaneously in fast-changing environments
Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Word)
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Strong organizational skills
Ability to work under tight deadlines and prioritize responsibilities
Ability to handle and maintain confidential information
Ability to learn new concepts and skills quickly

Successful candidates will be provided with outstanding career opportunities and will receive a competitive total rewards package with the opportunity to earn performance-based bonuses.

Target Hiring Range $110,000 - $150,000

Base pay is based on market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for a discretionary bonus and a comprehensive benefits package.

NVIDIA is synonymous with innovation, boasting trailblazers who are shaping the world with their forward-thinking approaches. This is your chance to be part of a vibrant community that's redefining the technological landscape. Ready to shape the future of automotive technology with NVIDIA? Apply now to be part of a team that's revolutionizing the industry and driving innovation to new heights. Your potential awaits!

Lead the lifecycle of NVIDIA’s DRIVE programs with our Korean automotive partners. Align on timelines and contents for SW deliveries incl. those of NVIDIA’s DRIVE OS, NDAS and Alpamayo software stacks.
Coordinate with cross functional teams in South Korea, India, China, and the U.S. to resolve program issues and drive product launches.
Act as the first point of contact and first level of escalation for our automotive partners and internal senior leadership, providing updates and bringing management focus on important issues.
Align on program vehicle and system level requirements, coordinate the review, exchange, and negotiation of them. Work closely with internal software groups to understand the design and implementation
Track and prioritize know issues and bugs, allocate fixes to upcoming SW releases, track verification, and root cause analysis.

General knowledge about Artificial Intelligence, LLMs, Transformers, CPU/GPU architectures, etc.

jobs.title: Senior Security Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

We're looking for an experienced and driven Senior Security Technical Program Manager to join Snap's Security Programs and Compliance Engineering (SPACE)
Team. This pivotal role is focused on establishing a mature, enterprise-wide cybersecurity framework essential for protecting our global user base, employees, and partners. You'll be the instrumental driver of the program for security: metrics, governance, operating cadence, cross-functional execution, and leadership accountability for security maturity outcomes.

What you’ll do:

Lead the design, build, and ongoing operation of security operations and risk programs that improve cyber maturity across core security foundations, including governance, intake, prioritization, escalation, and remediation follow-through.
Define and operationalize security KRIs, KPIs, and health metrics across key domains such as vulnerability management, incident response, detection and response effectiveness, control performance, remediation timeliness, and recurring risk themes.
Establish a consistent measurement framework, dashboarding model, and reporting taxonomy so security leaders can review trends, identify material gaps, and drive accountable action across their teams.
Prepare and present regular business reviews for security leadership that translate technical signals into clear risk narratives, decisions, priorities, and follow-up actions.
Build the operating cadence for security team leadership, including program reviews, metric reviews, escalation forums, and quarterly planning rhythms that connect strategy to execution.
Establish a common organizational framework for security team OKRs, including goal setting, dependency management, milestone tracking, evidence of progress, and end-of-quarter readouts.
Partner across Security, Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, and Operations to align program priorities, resolve blockers, and ensure consistent execution of risk reduction workstreams.
Drive root-cause analysis and remediation governance for significant operational issues, ensuring lessons learned are translated into durable process, technology, or control improvements.
Create and maintain a portfolio view of security initiatives, risks, dependencies, and commitments, and use that view to support prioritization, staffing discussions, and leadership tradeoff decisions.
Define standard methods for risk intake, issue tracking, exception handling, escalation thresholds, and verified closure to improve consistency across the security organization.
Improve the rigor of security operations by identifying opportunities for workflow simplification, automation, and better decision support, reducing toil while increasing transparency and accountability.
Develop executive-ready briefing materials, scorecards, and narratives that clearly communicate program status, emerging risks, mitigation plans, and areas requiring leadership intervention.
Monitor program performance over time and recommend changes to operating models, metrics, and review mechanisms to continuously raise the maturity of security operations and risk management practices.

Knowledge, skills, & abilities:

Depth of security experience and familiarity with a broad range of information security concepts and principles
Proven experience of running critical programs within a security field
Experience working with engineers, driving large security projects that have had a proven impact
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with mastery in the ability to tailor the message to the audience
Experience influencing teams and other cross-functional stakeholders to drive security programs
Proficiency in, or a strong aptitude for, leveraging AI tools to streamline development, paired with the critical judgment to audit generated output for architectural integrity, performance bottlenecks, and security risks.
Adaptability in learning and applying evolving AI systems and tools to remain at the forefront of engineering trends and modern development practices.

Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field or equivalent experience
6+ years of experience in security advisory space, technical program management or security solution delivery

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with with NIST CSF 2.0, NIS2, or ISO 27001
Experience with CISSP, CISM, CCSP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or similar certifications a plus

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information.

"Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week.

At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, where applicable).

Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long-term success!

jobs.title: Integration Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

BridgeNet Solutions, a member of the PSA Group, has provided sourcing, analytics, and technology solutions to help

customers achieve their strategic objectives since 2001. BridgeNet's customer base spans Fortune 500 and Global 2000, and

with annual logistics spend under management of over $5.4 billion, is well positioned to support its customers' complex

global supply chains.

Role Summary

The Integration Project Manager is the dedicated project management lead for all carrier, 3PL, and LSP systems integrations

across BridgeNet’s managed programs. This role owns the end-to-end project lifecycle of each integration initiative—from

kickoff and scoping through go-live and stabilization—working at the intersection of BridgeNet’s digital team, external

partner technical and account management resources, and internal program leadership. The Integration Project Manager is

not a developer or coder; this role is the driver, tracker, and communicator who ensures every integration moves forward on

schedule. Success requires relentless follow-through, structured project management discipline, strong cross-functional

communication, and the ability to hold internal and external stakeholders accountable in complex, multi-party environments.

Key Responsibilities

Integration Project Execution

Own the full project lifecycle for each carrier, 3PL, and LSP integration, from initial scoping and kickoff through technical

testing, UAT, go-live, and post-launch stabilization.

Build, maintain, and distribute detailed integration project plans with clearly defined milestones, owners, dependencies,

and due dates for all parties.

Coordinate with LSP technical contacts and BridgeNet technology teams to ensure integrations are built accurately,

tested thoroughly, and delivered on schedule.

Track all open action items and deliverables across BridgeNet’s digital team, partner technical contacts, and partner

account management teams; proactively chase outstanding items before they become delays.

Identify project risks and blockers early; escalate to the appropriate internal leader or partner account management

contact to resolve before they impact the integration timeline.

Manage simultaneous integration projects across multiple partners and workstreams, maintaining clear prioritization

and progress visibility for each.

Ensure global consistency in LSP integration design standards, preventing redundant or conflicting approaches across

different carriers and geographies

Partner & Stakeholder Coordination

Serve as the primary point of contact for all integration-related scheduling, coordination, and communication with carrier, 3PL, and LSP partners—engaging both technical resources (developers, EDI/API teams) and account management contacts.
Organize and lead integration kickoff meetings, standing syncs, technical working sessions, and testing checkpoints with all relevant parties; ensure agendas are distributed in advance and clear action items are captured and followed up after every meeting.
Push partners to align required technical and account resources to the integration project and hold them accountable to committed timelines.
Communicate clearly and professionally with partners at all levels; translate technical progress into business-relevant status language when communicating with account management or client-facing contacts. Digital Team Interface
Work closely with BridgeNet’s internal developers, coders, and integration architects to understand technical requirements, map dependencies, and build realistic project timelines.
Facilitate requirements handoffs and feedback loops between BridgeNet’s digital team and partner technical contacts, ensuring mapping specifications, API documentation, and test scenarios are complete and well-understood by all parties.
Remove administrative and coordination blockers for BridgeNet’s developers so technical work is not delayed by scheduling, access, or communication gaps.
Manage the UAT and go-live checkpoint process, coordinating test execution between internal and external teams and tracking defect resolution to closure. Communication & Reporting
Provide regular integration status updates to internal program leadership and, where required, to the end customer; communicate timelines, milestones achieved, risks, and expected resolution dates in a clear, structured format.
Maintain a consolidated integration tracker and status dashboard that reflects real-time progress across all active integration projects.
Document integration specifications, decisions, and lessons learned to support institutional knowledge and future onboarding of new partners.
Escalate unresolved timeline slippage or partner resource gaps to the Principal Solution Architect with a clear summary of the issue, impact, and recommended path to resolution.
Validate that integrated data flows from LSPs meet the Control Tower's operational data quality, timeliness, and completeness requirements.

Job Requirements

EDUCATION Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Supply Chain, Business, Information Systems, or a related field. Or equivalent work experience.

YEARS OF EXPERIENCE 3+ years in project management; 1+ years managing technology integration or systems onboarding projects involving third-party partners.

Required Skills & Competencies

Demonstrated experience managing multi-party technology integration projects end-to-end, including requirements

gathering, timeline management, testing coordination, and go-live execution across ocean, air, parcel, and road mode of

transportation types.

Strong project management methodology foundation (PMI/PMP, Agile, or hybrid); hands-on proficiency with tools such

as Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Jira, or equivalent.

Hands-on experience designing and delivering EDI, API, or flat-file integrations
Proven ability to drive external partners—including vendor account management and technical teams—to meet

committed timelines and deliverables.

Comfortable working directly with software developers, integration architects, EDI/API specialists, and data mapping

teams; able to facilitate technical conversations without being the technical subject matter expert.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills; capable of producing clear status reports, meeting recaps, and

escalation summaries for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent integration projects with competing priorities and geographically distributed stakeholders. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
PMP certification or equivalent project management credential.
Experience with EDI (EDIFACT, ANSI X12), JSON/REST API, or similar logistics data exchange standards.
Background in logistics, freight forwarding, managed transportation, or supply chain technology platforms.
Experience in 4PL or managed logistics program environments, particularly in energy, oil and gas, or industrial sectors.
Familiarity with TMS, WMS, or supply chain visibility platforms and their integration architectures. TRAVEL REQUIRED: Yes — up to 20% PHYSICAL CAPABILITIES This position is considered sedentary. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit, stand, walk, use hands and arms, and communicate verbally and in writing. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.

jobs.title: Senior Security Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

We're looking for an experienced and driven Senior Security Technical Program Manager to join Snap's Security Programs and Compliance Engineering (SPACE)
Team. This pivotal role is focused on establishing a mature, enterprise-wide cybersecurity framework essential for protecting our global user base, employees, and partners. You'll be the instrumental driver of the program for security: metrics, governance, operating cadence, cross-functional execution, and leadership accountability for security maturity outcomes.

What you’ll do:

Lead the design, build, and ongoing operation of security operations and risk programs that improve cyber maturity across core security foundations, including governance, intake, prioritization, escalation, and remediation follow-through.
Define and operationalize security KRIs, KPIs, and health metrics across key domains such as vulnerability management, incident response, detection and response effectiveness, control performance, remediation timeliness, and recurring risk themes.
Establish a consistent measurement framework, dashboarding model, and reporting taxonomy so security leaders can review trends, identify material gaps, and drive accountable action across their teams.
Prepare and present regular business reviews for security leadership that translate technical signals into clear risk narratives, decisions, priorities, and follow-up actions.
Build the operating cadence for security team leadership, including program reviews, metric reviews, escalation forums, and quarterly planning rhythms that connect strategy to execution.
Establish a common organizational framework for security team OKRs, including goal setting, dependency management, milestone tracking, evidence of progress, and end-of-quarter readouts.
Partner across Security, Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, and Operations to align program priorities, resolve blockers, and ensure consistent execution of risk reduction workstreams.
Drive root-cause analysis and remediation governance for significant operational issues, ensuring lessons learned are translated into durable process, technology, or control improvements.
Create and maintain a portfolio view of security initiatives, risks, dependencies, and commitments, and use that view to support prioritization, staffing discussions, and leadership tradeoff decisions.
Define standard methods for risk intake, issue tracking, exception handling, escalation thresholds, and verified closure to improve consistency across the security organization.
Improve the rigor of security operations by identifying opportunities for workflow simplification, automation, and better decision support, reducing toil while increasing transparency and accountability.
Develop executive-ready briefing materials, scorecards, and narratives that clearly communicate program status, emerging risks, mitigation plans, and areas requiring leadership intervention.
Monitor program performance over time and recommend changes to operating models, metrics, and review mechanisms to continuously raise the maturity of security operations and risk management practices.

Knowledge, skills, & abilities:

Depth of security experience and familiarity with a broad range of information security concepts and principles
Proven experience of running critical programs within a security field
Experience working with engineers, driving large security projects that have had a proven impact
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with mastery in the ability to tailor the message to the audience
Experience influencing teams and other cross-functional stakeholders to drive security programs
Proficiency in, or a strong aptitude for, leveraging AI tools to streamline development, paired with the critical judgment to audit generated output for architectural integrity, performance bottlenecks, and security risks.
Adaptability in learning and applying evolving AI systems and tools to remain at the forefront of engineering trends and modern development practices.

Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field or equivalent experience
6+ years of experience in security advisory space, technical program management or security solution delivery

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with with NIST CSF 2.0, NIS2, or ISO 27001
Experience with CISSP, CISM, CCSP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or similar certifications a plus

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information.

jobs.title: IT Security Manager - IAM Architect / Lead
jobs.description:
Wolters Kluwer Global Business Services (GBS) is designed to provide services to the business units in the areas of technology, sourcing, procurement, legal, finance, and human resources. These global centers promote team collaboration using best practices around a specific focus area to drive results and enhance operational efficiencies. There is a constant endeavor to benchmark against best-in-class industry standards to improve the quality of deliverables, increase cost savings, enhance productivity and reduce time to market for products and applications.

We have an amazing opportunity for a IAM lead architect, IT Security available within our Global Business Services division. This position has been created due to growth. IAM lead Architect, IT Security will be Accountable and Responsible for defining the identity fabric — the standards, reference architectures, and integration patterns and working closely with project teams as well as internal / external groups to protect and enhance the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of Wolters Kluwer assets.

This position location is Pune or Chennai, India .

As IAM lead Architect, IT Security, you will be accountable for defining IAM architectures, standards, road maps for all our IAM programs to secure access to personal and confidential information at Wolters Kluwer. In this role, you will be required to demonstrate proficiency in identity and access concepts as they pertain to every area of security management. Your role will also include interfacing with all other areas of the security organization and responding to 3rd party audits and internal audits, and interfacing with internal business unit IT representatives on global information security initiatives and compliance tasks and projects.

Key Responsibilities:

Define and own the enterprise identity architecture strategy, reference architectures, and engineering standards aligned to business and regulatory requirements across US and EU jurisdictions.
Produce and maintain the IAM RACI — resolving ownership boundaries between Access Management, IGA, Privileged IAM, Access Management, and NHI pillars.
Establish and govern the IAM Architecture Review Board (ARB), ensuring architectural sign-off on all material identity, access, and authentication changes.
Own the identity fabric design — the authoritative directory model, hybrid sync strategy, group and role taxonomy, and attribute schema across AD and Entra ID.
Define integration standards for all IAM tool-to-tool connections: SailPoint to AD, CyberArk to Entra PIM, CIEM to SIEM, and emerging NHI tooling.

Zero Trust and Cloud IAM Architecture

Architect and enforce Zero Trust identity controls across hybrid and multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), including least-privilege, just-in-time access, and continuous access evaluation.
Define cloud IAM governance standards: Entra ID tenant architecture, AWS IAM permission boundaries, Azure RBAC design, and GCP IAM policy structure.
Drive the architectural strategy for CIEM integration — ensuring cloud entitlement visibility, toxic combination detection, and least-privilege remediation at scale.
Own the identity component of the organization’s Zero Trust roadmap, including micro-segmentation, device trust, and identity-aware network policy.

NHI and AI Identity Architecture

Define the Non-Human Identity (NHI) governance architecture — covering service accounts, managed identities, service principals, pipeline identities, and AI agent identities.
Design the secrets management architecture integrating CyberArk Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, and CI/CD OIDC federation for keyless pipeline authentication.
Architect the AI agent identity model — defining how AI agents authenticate, what permissions they hold, how their actions are audited, and how their lifecycle is governed.
Produce architectural guidance for MCP server identity controls and LLM API key governance for emerging AI tooling (Claude Code, Copilot, custom agents).

Regulatory and Compliance Architecture

Ensure identity architecture satisfies GDPR, NIS2, DORA, SOC 2 Type II, and ISO 27001 requirements across all operating regions.
Translate evolving regulatory requirements (EU AI Act, Cyber Resilience Act, SEC cybersecurity rules) into actionable identity architecture changes.
Partner with Legal, Privacy, and Data Protection Officers to embed Privacy-by-Design and data minimization at the identity architecture layer.
Maintain the IAM architecture risk register — classifying, prioritizing, and driving remediation of architectural debt and control gaps.

Cross-Pillar Governance

Serve as the primary architectural authority for the IAM program — covering Access Management and Controls and Audit operationally where dedicated leads are not yet in place.
Chair the IAM Architecture Guild, fostering a community of practice across distributed identity engineers in US and EU time zones.
Present identity architecture posture and program progress to the IAM Owner, CISO, and executive leadership.
Evaluate and govern the IAM toolchain — rationalizing tool overlap, driving consolidation decisions, and managing vendor relationships for identity platforms.

Identifying and mitigating potential risks associated with the design and construction phases and establishing risk mitigation measures to suit.

Description

SAIC is seeking a qualified Naval Surface Warfare Officer specialized in Integrated Air and Missile Defense (IAMD) to support the US Air Force Collaborative Operations for Battlespace Resilient Architecture (COBRA) program in Kaiserslautern, Germany as a Maritime Surface Warfare Operations Analyst (Senior).

COBRA is the premier agency responsible for implementation, integration, and development of Modeling and Simulation (M&S) and training and analysis standards that support the US Air Force (USAF), Department of Defense (DoD), and mission partners by providing the Warfighter a full-spectrum training environment.

This position supports the USAFE-AFAFRICA Warfare Center (UAWC) at Einsiedlerhof AS, Germany. Success in this position directly impacts the training readiness of USAF, Joint Force, and Allied military forces in Europe and across the globe. Duties will include, but are not limited to

Support the operational and technical aspects of maritime Anti-Air Warfare (AAW) and Ballistic Missile Defense (BMD) integration into Live, Virtual, and Constructive (LVC) scenarios to exercise and validate planned air and missile defense designs, concepts, and procedures.
Prepare, coordinate, and present Maritime Surface Warfare briefings.
Lead Maritime Surface Warfare discussions with a wide range of audiences as requested by the Government.
Provide Maritime Surface Warfare operations expertise for all UAWC supported training exercises and events.
Support Tier 1-4 exercises including, but not limited to, large force exercises integrating joint, combined, allied, and other partner nations’ forces in an air, land, and sea battlespace, and support smaller scenarios integrating specific capabilities.
Generate documents and mission materials in support of exercise scenarios. These include, but are not limited, to Naval Operational Taskings (OPTASKs), Air Operations Directive (AOD), Airspace Control Plan (ACP), Air Tasking Order (ATO), Airspace Control Order (ACO), Area Air Defense Plan (AADP), Special Instructions (SPINs), Orders of Battle (OOB), red air plans, briefings, and mission cards.
Perform White / Blue / Red Force functions during execution of Tier 1-4 exercises and training events with virtual and constructive models. These include but are not limited to Future Force Experimentation Air Defense Simulation (FFEADS), International Simulation (ISim), Modern Air Combat Environment (MACE), and Next Generation Threat System (NGTS).
Lead all aspects of Joint Event Life Cycle (JELC) planning, including concept development, planning conferences, mission planning, white force briefs, mass briefs, execution, debriefs, and after-action report completion with the exercise audiences.

Qualifications

Bachelor's and 9 years of experience conducting Maritime Surface Warfare operations, or 20 years of relevant experience in lieu of degree.
CRUDES TAO and Force TAO (Air Warfare) with operational experience within 5 years, and with a minimum of 10 years of operational experience.
In-depth knowledge of the Joint Operations Planning Process (JOPP).
Must be a US Citizen with minimally Secret clearance and able to obtain Top Secret / SCI.

Desired Qualifications And Experience

USN IAMD WTI graduate.
Previous qualification as an Upper-Tier Coordination Officer.
Previous qualification as a BMD Watch Officer.
Familiarity with Missile Defense Agency (MDA) processes and planning.
Tactical Data Link experience.

This is a remote role that may be hired in several markets across the United States.

As a Senior Incident Response Analyst, you'll be a member of the bank's Cyber Incident Response team. We are looking for an experienced senior level analyst with proven skillsets to detect and respond to threats in the environment, interact with business stakeholders and work to restore operations. This is a technical role and will support the Threat Hunting, Intelligence, and Monitoring functions with content creation, threat analysis, detection recommendations, and colleague mentoring. Incident Analyst/handler –investigate SIEM/SOAR events as necessary; bring experience in malware analysis, network/endpoint security to respond to and contain incidents.

jobs.title: EDI Data Analyst
jobs.description:
At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.

Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25-year-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.

While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America

Position Overview

The Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Analyst is responsible for managing, maintaining, and optimizing electronic data transactions between McCormick and its global business trading partners. This role ensures seamless system integration, accurate data exchange, and compliance with industry standards across multiple businesses and international locations.

The EDI Analyst works within a complex, multi-system environment, supporting business operations through interface automation, data conversion, error resolution, and system improvements. This position requires collaboration with internal teams (IT, Supply Chain, Finance, Sales & Distribution, and Customer Service) and external partners (suppliers, customers, banks, logistics provides and other third-party service providers) to ensure efficient and secure data flow.

Primary Purpose

The purpose of this role is to drive operational efficiency by ensuring reliable, accurate, and automated data transactions. By managing EDI processes, integrations, and compliance, the EDI Analyst reduces manual effort, minimizes errors, and enhances overall business performance.

This role also plays a critical part in continuous improvement and digital transformation, identifying opportunities for process automation, system optimization, and enhanced data governance. Through proactive monitoring, troubleshooting, and innovation, the EDI Analyst strengthens the organization's ability to execute seamless electronic transactions and maintains strong relationships with business partners.

Key Responsibilities

EDI Monitoring & Error Resolution
Monitors, maintains, and troubleshoots EDI transactions in various EDI standards across Order Management, Logistics, Purchasing, Disbursements, Finance, Billing, Planning, and Sales & Distribution areas.
Provides administrative support, error documentation, testing and resolution to ensure seamless electronic data exchange.
Supports EDI operations globally covering EMEA, NA and APAC, APZ countries.
EDI Integration & Partner Management
Establishes and maintains EDI connections with business trading partners, managing inbound and outbound, internal, and inter-company data flows.
